evidence.quote: The Book of Church Order , commonly referred to as BCO , is part of the constitution of the Presbyterian Church in America, which is subject to and subordinate to the Scriptures of the Old and New Testaments, the inerrant Word Of God.

The Constitution of the Presbyterian Church in America (PCA) is subject to and subordinate to the Scriptures of the Old and New Testaments, the inerrant Word of God and only infallible rule of faith and practice.
